findings.title: Require census stdout/stderr EOF before using its row table for absence
findings.evidence: The native ps Popen is assigned at186. Each nonblocking pipe read can stop on BlockingIOError at196; no stdout/stderr EOF flags are retained. At200 a now-terminal poll immediately permits parsing psout and observe(rows), then quiet/finalize/reap/group-empty/publication decisions at209–228. A final ps write between EAGAIN and poll can leave a syntactically valid complete-row prefix whose missing suffix was never drained. Process raw0 does not prove all pipe bytes were consumed. Census PID/PGID/raw/EOF receipts are also absent from the published ownership inventory.
findings.impact: A partial census can become the watchdog own fresh absence/quiet observation. Required later independent root terminal/absence receipts remain necessary and may refuse; this finding does not assert an observed leaked process or successful false validation. The helper itself does not satisfy its complete fresh-census/pipe-settlement contract.
findings.minimumCorrection: In a separately reviewed successor, immediately retain/register every census handle/PID/PGID, track each pipe EOF, retain complete bounded actual stdout/stderr and raw terminal before parsing a census as whole. Keep the same200ms probe cutoff and original whole clock; incomplete/overflow/nonzero/unknown remains sticky refusal with safely owned cleanup, no reinterpreted partial prefix. Retain bounded census creation/terminal/EOF records in final evidence and require fresh root absence for all recorded probe identities.
findings.futureFiniteControls: Within existing C13/C15/C16 descriptions, concrete separately reviewed zero-product stimuli for EAGAIN then final complete-row suffix+exit, missing EOF/held writer and failed census. They remain UNPREPARED/UNEXECUTED; no cap/time/retry widening.

findings.title: Bind clean-versus-dirty archive attribution to the actual source tuple
findings.evidence: source_check explicitly accepts either exactly four reviewed dirty paths on base283 or a root-bound clean candidate whose HEAD contains all681 bytes. packages.py always emits clean:false and says Base commit does not contain the draft, even when g._sourceBinding.dirtyPaths is empty. No clean execution tuple exists yet; current source4 is still the reviewed dirty basis.
findings.impact: The advertised supported clean-candidate branch would publish false source provenance. This is an attribution defect, not source drift or an observed package/build failure.
findings.minimumCorrection: Derive clean and the human sourceAttribution statement from the independently bound actual dirtyPaths/HEAD tuple. Preserve exact dirty-base before/after checks, exact clean HEAD checks and all payload/archive hashes. No guessed future commit or semantic source change.
